text:
support-ops: Heads up — FalconRetail escalated. Multiple streaming responses truncated mid-stream and were counted as 5xx, customer is disputing billing. They attached curl + proxy logs and a few request IDs. @sre-oncall can you triage?

sre-oncall: On it. Can you paste the request IDs and any raw logs? Do we have region and model?

support-ops: Req IDs: cr-9f3a, cr-9f3b, cr-9f3c. Region: us-west-2, hosted inference (streaming). Model: rw-medium-2025. Payloads ~8k tokens before final chunks. Proxy log snippet from customer below:

```
[2026-03-14T11:03:05Z] proxy: conn from client 10.2.3.5 -> upstream 10.8.1.22
[2026-03-14T11:03:07Z] proxy: upstream closed connection: ECONNRESET
[2026-03-14T11:03:07Z] proxy: client closed connection: FIN_WAIT
[2026-03-14T11:03:07Z] classifier: marked as 502 (upstream reset)
```

They say customer closed client (ctrl-c) but we still billed and marked 5xx.

sre-oncall: Hmm — classifier picked upstream reset first. If client FIN happens then our code should classify as client abort (not bill). Possible race: upstream resets while client already half-closed. @devon any prior context on half-close ordering?

devon: I ran a quick repro locally. Steps:
1) curl -v -N -H "Transfer-Encoding: chunked" -d @payload https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate
2) wait for several chunks then ctrl-c
Result: proxy log shows FIN from client followed ~10ms by upstream RST. Our classifier logic currently checks upstream socket error before client EOF flag -> labels 5xx.

devon: Repro snippet (staging):
```
client: FIN received
upstream: RST due to half-close race
our-classifier: error_type = upstream_error -> http_status = 502
expected: classify as client_abort / 499-equivalent
```

sre-bot: ALERT: Streaming_EOF_Surge detected (2026-03-14T11:00:00Z - 2026-03-14T11:15:00Z): 24 events, 18 labeled 5xx.

ivy: FYI — we rolled out a change last week that reduced proxy read-timeout from 30s -> 15s in us-west-2 to reduce idle threads. That could make the race more likely if clients are doing long-lived streams + network flakiness.

alex: If these are misclassified client disconnects we should credit usage. How do we identify affected requests programmatically? Do we rely on logs or can we retro-run a classifier?

devon: Short-term patch: change classifier ordering to check client EOF/halfclose flag before mapping upstream socket errors to 5xx. Also add metric tag suspected_client_abort so billing can filter. I can open a hotfix PR now. Expected: patch + deploy to canary in ~1-2 hrs.

support-ops: Customer is asking for ETA on credits and a short repro/RCA. They provided the time window 2026-03-14 11:02-11:12 UTC with the req IDs above. CX asks for estimate within 1 hour.

maria: Plan: (1) hotfix reorder classifier to prefer client EOF -> canary deploy in us-west-2 (1-2 hrs), (2) collect metric tag for suspected_client_abort and run retrospection over the given window to identify misbilled requests (2-4 hrs), (3) roll stable + publish RCA. @alex calculate provisional credit based on token/time window. @support-ops please communicate 3-hr ETA to CX.

devon: Opening PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/proxy/compare/PR-xxxx with unit tests that force EPIPE/EINTR ordering. Also adding an integration test that simulates ctrl-c during streaming.

alex: I'll start the billing query for the window and flag any requests with the new metric (once available). If we need immediate manual credits we can do a provisional adjustment.

support-ops: Thanks all. I'll message FalconRetail: propose provisional credit + update in 3 hours once hotfix is live. Will post follow-up here with canary results. :thumbsup:

customer-falconretail: Appreciate the quick attention. We can provide pcap/verbose curl traces if it helps reproduce. Please keep us posted — this hit a few high-value requests.

sre-oncall: Noted. Devon, please ping when PR is merged so we can kick off canary. I'll also add a short-runbook for ops to identify suspected_client_abort events in the interim.

support-ops: Filed an internal incident ticket: INC-2026-3743 for tracking credits + RCA.

maria: Good. After hotfix and canary, we should consider adding a metric that explicitly records the race-case (client-fin then upstream-rst) so we can proactively alert before billing escalations.

devon: Agreed. Adding that to the PR. Will update thread with PR/link and canary timestamp.

support-ops: Thread closed for now — will reopen with canary outcome.
